subject.title: Google Chat: Add threaded reply support + receive all messages in spaces

question: Should the bundled Google Chat plugin add first-class all-message Space ingestion now, and if so should it use user OAuth, Workspace Events/Pub/Sub, or another explicitly approved Google Chat event path?
rationale: The remaining request is not a mechanical adapter patch: it changes Google credential scope, message visibility, token/secret storage, event delivery architecture, and operator setup expectations.

options.title: Approve plugin-owned all-message design
options.body: Implement the feature in the Google Chat plugin with SecretRef/redaction support, explicit scopes or subscriptions, service-account fallback behavior, docs, tests, and live Google Chat Space proof.

options.title: Split to existing canonical work
options.body: Keep thread PRs focused on threaded delivery and route the OAuth/event-ingestion design through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/9764 or a narrower maintainer-owned design issue before coding.

options.title: Defer all-message ingestion
options.body: Document service-account mention-only behavior as the supported Google Chat mode for now and revisit broader Space ingestion only with a sponsored security/product design.

recommendation.title: Approve plugin-owned all-message design
recommendation.body: Implement the feature in the Google Chat plugin with SecretRef/redaction support, explicit scopes or subscriptions, service-account fallback behavior, docs, tests, and live Google Chat Space proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He has recent maintainer-side review context and committer history across both Google Chat thread behavior and auth/config surfaces.
